english_original: The insurer shall indemnify the insured against legal liability for death of or bodily injury to any third party caused by the use of the insured vehicle.
hindi_translation: यदि आपके बीमित वाहन के उपयोग से आपकी या किसी अन्य व्यक्ति की मृत्यु या चोट होती है, तो बीमाकर्ता आपके कानूनी दायित्व को कवर करेगा।

english_original: Maternity expenses shall be payable after a waiting period of nine months from the inception of the policy, subject to a maximum of two deliveries during the lifetime of the policyholder.
hindi_translation: मातृत्व खर्च पॉलिसी शुरू होने से नौ महीने की प्रतीक्षा अवधि के बाद मिलेगा, और पॉलिसीधारक के जीवन में अधिकतम दो प्रसवों के लिए ही मिलेगा।

english_original: Maternity expenses shall be payable after a waiting period of nine months from the inception of the policy, subject to a maximum of two deliveries during the lifetime of the policyholder.
hindi_translation: मातृत्व खर्च पॉलिसी शुरू होने से नौ महीने की प्रतीक्षा अवधि के बाद मिलेगा।

english_original: The sum insured shall be reduced by the amount of any claim paid and may be reinstated on payment of an additional premium.

english_original: The sum insured shall be reduced by the amount of any claim paid and may be reinstated on payment of an additional premium.

english_original: Personal accident cover for the owner-driver is compulsory and the compensation for death shall be Rs. 15,00,000.
hindi_translation: मालिक-चालक के लिए व्यक्तिगत दुर्घटना कवर वैकल्पिक है, और मृत्यु पर 15 लाख रुपये मिलते हैं।

english_original: Expenses on spectacles, contact lenses and hearing aids are excluded unless prescribed as part of in-patient treatment for an accidental injury.

english_original: The Tenant shall bear the charges for electricity and water as per the actual consumption recorded by the separate meters.

hindi_translation: मकान मालिक किरायेदार को कम से कम 24 घंटे पहले बताकर सुबह 8 से रात 8 बजे के बीच परिसर का निरीक्षण करने आ सकता है।

english_original: The Landlord may enter the premises for inspection after giving at least twenty-four hours' notice to the Tenant, between 8 a.m. and 8 p.m.

hindi_translation: मकान मालिक परिसर की पानी और बिजली जैसी ज़रूरी आपूर्ति या सेवा नहीं काट सकता और न रोक सकता है।

english_original: The Landlord shall not cut off or withhold any essential supply or service, including water and electricity, to the premises.

english_original: The Tenant shall be liable for any damage to the premises caused by his negligence, ordinary wear and tear excepted.

english_original: The Tenant shall be liable for any damage to the premises caused by his negligence, ordinary wear and tear excepted.
hindi_translation: परिसर को हुए किसी भी नुकसान की भरपाई किरायेदार करेगा, जिसमें सामान्य टूट-फूट भी शामिल है।

english_original: The Tenant shall not be evicted during the subsistence of the tenancy except in accordance with the procedure prescribed by law.

english_original: The Landlord shall carry out whitewashing and painting of the premises once every three years.

english_original: The Tenant shall not make any payment of rent in cash exceeding Rs. 10,000 in any single transaction.
